summary: The document contains methods for facilitating the localization of UI components within the HSPnet application. It specifically enables the translation of fields and file types and manages the language settings for user sessions.
purpose: To provide functionality for translating UI elements and handling different language settings based on user session configurations, allowing for alternate language representations in the HSPnet UI.

workflows.name: Translate Fields
steps: Check if alternate language fields are to be used.
Iterate over each field and corresponding new value pair.
Determine if the field is a Literal or Label and update its text.

workflows.name: Translate File Type
steps: Check if session object is provided.
Determine language setting from the session.
Return the alternate file type if using alternate language fields.

workflows.name: Translate Last Login
steps: Check if alternate language fields are to be used.
Replace month names in the last login string with their alternate language equivalents.

business_rules: Fields and newValues arrays must be of the same size for translation.
If the session object is null, default to using English fields.
conditions: UseAltLanguageFields is true for translations to proceed.
Control element is not null before attempting to update its text.
system_behavior: Updates field texts to translated versions depending on the language setting.
dependencies: System.Web.UI for Control, Literal, and Label classes.
